title: [3.0rc3] UI recalculates a lot on received NS confirmations
body:
AAPS: 3.0beta11
NS: 14.2.6
Android: 12

I paused NSClient for a while. When started, the queue was delivered as it should.
However, the AAPS main screen kept showing the recalculating message, starting again and again and 400, finally Android asked me to stop the app multiple times.

Video:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/123NaM3Wwh62HejVCtPNQUP6JdMAOgUN_/view?usp=sharing
